title: PEARS: Physical-Prior-Guided Efficient Adaptation via Failure Reasoning and Diffusion Steering for Tactile Manipulation
summary: Pretrained robotic policies can suffer substantial performance degradation under out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions encountered during deployment, motivating post-training through real-world interaction. However, reinforcement-learning (RL)-based post-training typically requires substantial environment interactions, a burden that is especially significant in manipulation, where each trial can be slow, costly, or destructive. Therefore, we present PEARS, a physics-prior-guided hybrid RL framework for sample-efficient online adaptation of pretrained policies with tactile feedback. After each episode, its physics-guided force reasoning (PFR) module uses physical priors encoded in a vision-language model (VLM) to diagnose failures from the visual outcome and tactile interaction history and update task-appropriate contact-force bounds. A high-frequency hybrid force-position controller then enforces these bounds during contact. Complementarily, tactile-conditioned diffusion steering reinforcement learning adjusts the latent noise of the frozen flow-matching policy to correct errors in free-space motion and contact timing without updating the base model. In simulation, PEARS improves success rates by 12.4-37.4 percentage points over the strongest per-task baselines. PEARS also reduces the number of interaction episodes required for a certain success threshold by up to 53.2% relative to the fastest baseline. In real-world experiments, PEARS achieves success rates of 95% on Whiteboard Erasing and 90% on Pipette Liquid Aspiration. These results show that combining the PFR module with policy steering can accelerate adaptation while reducing costly interactions. The project website is available at https://song-kun.github.io/pears.
tldr: PEARS introduces a physics-prior-guided hybrid RL framework that adapts pretrained tactile manipulation policies efficiently under OOD conditions by combining VLM-based failure reasoning, force-bound enforcement, and diffusion steering, achieving significant sample-efficiency gains in simulation and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: PEARS 提出了一种物理先验引导的混合强化学习框架，通过 VLM 故障推理、力边界约束和扩散引导，在触觉操作任务中实现高效 OOD 适应，显著减少交互样本。
summary_zh: 预训练机器人策略在部署过程中遇到分布外（OOD）条件时，可能会遭受严重的性能下降，这促使通过真实世界交互进行后训练。然而，基于强化学习（RL）的后训练通常需要大量的环境交互，这一负担在操作任务中尤为显著，因为每次试验可能缓慢、昂贵甚至具有破坏性。因此，我们提出了PEARS，一种物理先验引导的混合强化学习框架，用于利用触觉反馈对预训练策略进行样本高效的在线自适应。在每个回合结束后，其物理引导力推理（PFR）模块利用视觉语言模型（VLM）中编码的物理先验，从视觉结果和触觉交互历史中诊断失败，并更新适用于任务的接触力边界。随后，一个高频混合力-位置控制器在接触过程中强制执行这些边界。此外，触觉条件化的扩散引导强化学习调整冻结的流匹配策略的潜在噪声，以修正自由空间运动和接触时机中的误差，而无需更新基础模型。在仿真中，PEARS相对于各任务的最强基线将成功率提高了12.4至37.4个百分点。同时，PEARS达到特定成功阈值所需的交互回合数比最快基线减少了最多53.2%。在真实世界实验中，PEARS在黑板擦除任务中实现了95%的成功率，在移液器液体吸取任务中实现了90%的成功率。这些结果表明，将PFR模块与策略引导相结合可以加速自适应，同时减少昂贵的交互。项目网站可在https://song-kun.github.io/pears访问。

title: DepthWorld: 3D World Model for Robot Manipulation
summary: World models offer a data-driven alternative to traditional simulators for robotics, with applications spanning policy evaluation, improvement, and planning. All of these uses depend on faithful 3D geometry, yet current video-based world models are trained on RGB alone and produce rollouts that look correct frame-by-frame but do not compose into a consistent 3D world. Closing this gap requires progress on two fronts: large-scale 3D supervision for manipulation, and an architecture that can absorb it without disturbing strong pretrained video priors. We introduce a calibration pipeline that combines learned stereo depth with a joint factor graph, pooling all episodes collected from the same physical robot to recover its shared kinematic parameters alongside per-scene extrinsics. Applied to the DROID dataset, this yields DROID-3D, a calibrated 3D dataset providing dense metric depth and recalibrated multi-view extrinsics (achieving <0.7 px reprojection error on 90% of episodes for external cameras). We then train DepthWorld, a Stable Video Diffusion-based world model that jointly predicts multi-view RGB and depth via spatial latent tiling, leaving the pretrained Variational Autoencoder (VAE) unchanged. Depth supervision improves RGB prediction itself by +1.48 dB PSNR over an identical RGB-only baseline at equal training budget, while simultaneously yielding accurate metric depth for downstream geometric reasoning.
tldr: This paper introduces DepthWorld, a Stable Video Diffusion-based world model that jointly predicts multi-view RGB and depth for robot manipulation, enabled by a new calibration pipeline producing the DROID-3D dataset with metric depth and recalibrated extrinsics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了DepthWorld，一种基于Stable Video Diffusion的世界模型，可联合预测机器人操作任务中的多视角RGB和深度，并通过新的标定流程生成DROID-3D数据集（含度量深度和重新标定的外参）来实现。
summary_zh: 世界模型为机器人技术提供了一种基于数据的传统模拟器替代方案，其应用涵盖策略评估、策略改进和规划。所有这些用途都依赖于准确的3D几何信息，然而当前基于视频的世界模型仅使用RGB数据进行训练，生成的滚动序列在逐帧上看似正确，却无法组合成一致的3D世界。弥合这一差距需要在两个方面取得进展：一是用于操作的大规模3D监督，二是能够吸收这种监督且不干扰强大预训练视频先验的架构。我们引入了一种校准流程，将学习得到的立体深度与联合因子图相结合，汇集从同一物理机器人收集的所有片段，以恢复其共享的运动学参数以及每个场景的外部参数。将该流程应用于DROID数据集，我们生成了DROID-3D，这是一个经过校准的3D数据集，提供密集的度量深度和重新校准的多视角外部参数（在90%的外部相机片段中实现了<0.7像素的重投影误差）。随后，我们训练了DepthWorld，这是一个基于稳定视频扩散的世界模型，通过空间潜变量拼接联合预测多视角RGB和深度，同时保持预训练的自编码器（VAE）不变。在相同训练预算下，深度监督使RGB预测本身相较于仅使用RGB的基线模型提高了1.48 dB的PSNR，同时还为下游几何推理提供了准确的度量深度。

title: EgoLAP: Learning from Egocentric Human Data through Language-Action Reasoning
summary: Egocentric human data offer a path to scaling robot learning beyond costly robot demonstrations, yet the embodiment gap makes raw human trajectories a poor supervisory target for control. Our key insight is that, although low-level actions are embodiment-specific, their underlying motion intent can capture task-relevant structure that transfers across humans and robots. We introduce EgoLAP, a VLA pre-training framework that jointly learns from human and robot trajectories through a shared language-based action chain-of-thought. EgoLAP expresses motion intent as structured, temporally abstracted language actions and pairs them with motion-level reasoning grounded in scene geometry, physics, and object affordances. Across extensive real-world and simulated experiments, EgoLAP transfers human experience to robot control more effectively than alternative action representations and reaches 80.1% mean real-world task progress, a 2.3x performance gain over alternative action representations. Motion-level reasoning also outperforms a composite reasoning format that combines subtask, object-box, and visual-trace reasoning.
tldr: EgoLAP is a VLA pretraining framework that learns from egocentric human data and robot trajectories via a shared language-based action chain-of-thought, achieving 80.1% real-world task progress and outperforming alternative action representations.
tldr_zh: EgoLAP 是一个VLA预训练框架，通过共享的基于语言的动作思维链从自我中心人类数据和机器人轨迹中学习，实现了80.1%的真实世界任务进展，优于其他动作表示方法。
summary_zh: 以自我为中心的人类数据为扩展机器人学习提供了一条途径，无需依赖昂贵的机器人示范，然而具身差异使得原始人类轨迹难以成为有效的控制监督目标。我们的关键洞察在于，尽管低级动作具有具身特异性，但其背后的运动意图能够捕捉到跨越人类与机器人迁移的任务相关结构。为此，我们提出EgoLAP，一种视觉-语言-动作（VLA）预训练框架，通过共享的基于语言的动作思维链，联合学习人类与机器人轨迹。EgoLAP将运动意图表达为结构化的、时间抽象的语言动作，并将其与基于场景几何、物理及物体可操作性的运动级推理相结合。在广泛的真实世界与模拟实验中，EgoLAP在将人类经验迁移至机器人控制方面优于其他动作表示，平均真实世界任务进展达到80.1%，相较于替代动作表示实现了2.3倍的性能提升。运动级推理亦优于结合子任务、物体边界框及视觉轨迹推理的复合推理格式。

title: MIM-VLA: Learning Physical Interaction Representations from Gripper Motor Feedback
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies infer grasp actions primarily from visual observations and robot state, but do not explicitly represent the physical response observed after contact. We present MIM-VLA, a motor-feedback-based architecture that encodes recent gripper current, position, velocity, and signal validity as a 128-dimensional interaction token. A motor-only Motor Interaction Module (MIM) is pretrained with human-reviewed contact and interaction-phase labels and then conditions only the gripper-action pathway of SmolVLA; arm actions and the position-control interface remain unchanged. The same token supports the MEM selector VLM that compares candidate interactions and produces evidence-conditioned selections and explanations. We evaluate MIM-VLA in three real-world settings: comparing the interaction resistance of visually different objects, disambiguating visually similar real and replica objects through active probing, and gently grasping fragile objects, including held-out instances. Across 13 object pairs, MIM-VLA selects the higher-resistance object in 75.0% of trials, compared with 48.8% for the SmolVLA baseline. For the evaluated tasks, the approach uses motor feedback already available from the gripper and does not require an additional tactile array, force-torque sensor, calibrated force estimate, or direct current control.
tldr: MIM-VLA enhances VLA policies by encoding gripper motor feedback into an interaction token, improving physical interaction understanding and enabling tasks like distinguishing objects and gentle grasping without extra sensors.
tldr_zh: MIM-VLA 通过将夹爪电机反馈编码为交互标记，增强了 VLA 策略的物理交互理解，从而在不增加额外传感器的情况下改进物体辨识和轻柔抓取等任务。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略主要从视觉观察和机器人状态推断抓取动作，但并未显式建模接触后观测到的物理响应。我们提出MIM-VLA，一种基于电机反馈的架构，将近期夹爪电流、位置、速度及信号有效性编码为128维交互令牌。仅含电机的交互模块（MIM）使用经人工审核的接触与交互阶段标签进行预训练，随后仅对SmolVLA的夹爪动作通路施加条件约束；手臂动作及位置控制接口保持不变。同一令牌还支撑MEM选择器视觉语言模型，该模型比较候选交互并生成基于证据的选择与解释。我们在三个真实世界场景中评估MIM-VLA：比较视觉上不同物体的交互阻力、通过主动探测消解视觉上相似的实物与复制品之间的歧义，以及轻柔抓取脆弱物体（包括未见过的实例）。在13组物体对上，MIM-VLA在75.0%的试验中选出阻力更高的物体，而SmolVLA基线仅为48.8%。对于所评估的任务，该方法利用夹爪已有的电机反馈，无需额外触觉阵列、力-力矩传感器、标定力估计或直接电流控制。

title: VOMMI: Collecting and Leveraging Portable Demonstrations for Mobile Manipulation
summary: Portable mobile-manipulation demonstrations can help alleviate data scarcity for embodied intelligence, but obtaining reliable, low-cost, and robot-free motion supervision from RGB observations remains challenging. Existing approaches often rely on teleoperation or specialized devices equipped with additional sensing hardware, while directly using estimated visual odometry (VO) trajectories can introduce inconsistencies due to accumulated drift and imperfect motion supervision. We present the Visual-Odometry-Conditioned Mobile Manipulation Interface (VOMMI), a portable demonstration collection and learning framework that connects portable RGB demonstrations to vision-language-action (VLA) post-training through offline trajectory reconstruction and online visual-motion conditioning. VOMMI synchronizes body and hand views to capture navigation context and local object interactions without requiring human-robot kinematic correspondence calibration. R2-VO refines offline demonstration trajectories using sparse geometric anchors and produces causal local-motion tokens over multiple prediction horizons for online policy conditioning. An action-group residual adapter incorporates these tokens only into the base branch. Experiments use a 500-trajectory portable for each task, with 75 trajectories held out for RGB-VO evaluation, and 200 robot demonstrations as references. Our policy, post-trained only on portable demonstrations, achieves 18.2% lower base-velocity error than a policy trained with robot-collected demonstrations, while maintaining comparable end-effector translation accuracy. Offline reconstruction reduces absolute trajectory errors for the body and hand streams by 24.6% on average relative to the best evaluated baseline for each stream. The complete system improves the mean success rate by 8.3 percentage points over OpenPI 0.5 across three real-robot tasks.
tldr: VOMMI is a portable demonstration collection and learning framework that connects RGB-only demonstrations to VLA post-training via offline trajectory reconstruction and online visual-motion conditioning, improving base-velocity error and task success on real mobile manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: VOMMI 是一个便携式演示收集与学习框架，通过离线轨迹重建和在线视觉-运动条件将仅RGB演示连接到VLA后训练，在真实移动操作任务中降低了基准速度误差并提高了任务成功率。
summary_zh: 便携式移动操控演示有助于缓解具身智能领域的数据匮乏问题，但如何从RGB观测中获取可靠、低成本且无需机器人的运动监督仍具挑战性。现有方法通常依赖遥操作或配备额外传感硬件的专用设备，而直接使用估计的视觉里程计（VO）轨迹可能因累积漂移和不完善的运动监督而产生不一致性。我们提出了视觉里程计条件化移动操控接口（VOMMI），一种便携式演示采集与学习框架，通过离线轨迹重建和在线视觉-运动条件化，将便携式RGB演示与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）后训练相连接。VOMMI同步身体视角和手部视角，以捕捉导航上下文和局部物体交互，无需人机关节运动学对应标定。R2-VO利用稀疏几何锚点精炼离线演示轨迹，并在多个预测时域上生成因果局部运动标记，用于在线策略条件化。动作组残差适配器仅将这些标记融入基础分支。实验中每个任务使用500条便携式演示轨迹，其中75条留出用于RGB-VO评估，另以200条机器人演示作为参照。我们的策略仅基于便携式演示进行后训练，其基础速度误差比使用机器人采集演示训练的策略低18.2%，同时保持相当水平的末端执行器平移精度。离线重建将身体流和手部流的绝对轨迹误差较各自最优评估基线平均降低24.6%。完整系统在三个真实机器人任务上的平均成功率较OpenPI 0.5提升8.3个百分点。

title: ViDAL: A Visual Dynamics-Grounded Action Latent Space for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a central paradigm for robot policy learning, which predict actions in three forms: raw action chunks, discrete action tokens, or continuous action latents. However, existing action representations primarily model action trajectories, with limited consideration of the visual dynamics induced by these actions. We introduce ViDAL, a Visual Dynamics-grounded Action Latent Space that anchors continuous action latents in the future visual dynamics of the scene. Specifically, ViDAL learns action latent space by training an Action Variational Autoencoder (Action VAE) to reconstruct action chunks while aligning its latent with future scene dynamics. When integrated into downstream robot policies, the proposed Action VAE serves as a plug-in action interface compatible with multiple VLA architectures and enables optional future-video prediction as an additional capability. Empirically, ViDAL outperforms competitive baselines on LIBERO with 98.1% average success, improves a multi-task $π_{0.5}$ policy on RoboTwin 2.0 from 54.3% to 65.5% (Clean) and from 33.2% to 43.1% (Random) success rates over 50 dual-arm tasks, and yields 20.0% and 23.4% absolute success-rate gains on real-world single-arm Franka and dual-arm ARX robot platforms.
tldr: ViDAL introduces a visual dynamics-grounded action latent space, learning action VAE latents aligned with future scene dynamics, which improves VLA policies across simulation and real robots.
tldr_zh: ViDAL 提出一种视觉动态锚定的动作潜空间，通过学习与未来场景动态对齐的动作 VAE 潜变量，提升了仿真和实体机器人上的 VLA 策略性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为机器人策略学习的核心范式，其通过三种形式预测动作：原始动作块、离散动作标记或连续动作潜在表示。然而，现有的动作表示主要对动作轨迹进行建模，很少考虑由这些动作引发的视觉动态变化。我们提出ViDAL，一种基于视觉动态锚定的动作潜在空间，将连续动作潜在表示锚定于场景的未来视觉动态中。具体而言，ViDAL通过训练动作变分自编码器（Action VAE）重建动作块，同时将其潜在表示与未来场景动态对齐，从而学习动作潜在空间。集成到下游机器人策略中后，所提出的Action VAE可作为即插即用的动作接口，兼容多种VLA架构，并支持可选的未来视频预测作为附加功能。实验表明，ViDAL在LIBERO基准上以98.1%的平均成功率超越竞争基线，在RoboTwin 2.0的50个双臂任务上将多任务\(\pi_{0.5}\)策略的成功率从54.3%提升至65.5%（干净场景）、从33.2%提升至43.1%（随机场景），并在真实世界的单臂Franka和双臂ARX机器人平台上分别带来20.0%和23.4%的绝对成功率提升。

title: iGPC: Generative Motion Priors for Object-Aware Humanoid Interaction
summary: Humanoid robots operating in unstructured environments must combine robust whole-body control with the ability to perceive and physically interact with surrounding objects. While large-scale human motion data provides powerful priors for natural and versatile humanoid control, effectively transferring such priors to perception-driven object interaction remains challenging. To address this bottleneck, we propose a framework that extends the recently proposed Generative Pretrained Controller (GPC) from general human motion to full-body humanoid-environment interaction. First, we adapt GPC into interaction experts conditioned on scene affordance cues and privileged state information. These experts leverage the pretrained human motion prior while learning task-specific contact behaviors, including reaching toward objects, grasping environmental supports for stabilization, and pushing movable objects. Second, we introduce a perception-driven student that retains the pretrained GPC policy and distills interaction skills from the experts using onboard sensory observations. To bridge the gap between privileged expert observations and sensory inputs, we propose two complementary training objectives that enable effective adaptation of the pretrained motion prior during distillation. Notably, our experiments across multiple whole-body interaction tasks demonstrate that large-scale generative human motion priors provide an effective foundation for learning deployable policies for humanoid interactions in contact-rich real-world environments.
tldr: This paper extends the Generative Pretrained Controller (GPC) to enable object-aware humanoid interaction by distilling privileged interaction experts into a perception-driven student, demonstrating that generative human motion priors facilitate deployable whole-body policies for contact-rich tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文扩展了生成式预训练控制器（GPC），通过将特权交互专家蒸馏为感知驱动的学生策略，实现物体感知的人形机器人交互，证明生成式人体运动先验有助于学习可部署的全身接触丰富任务策略。
summary_zh: 人形机器人在非结构化环境中作业时，必须兼具鲁棒的全身控制能力以及感知并物理交互周围物体的能力。尽管大规模人体运动数据为自然且多才多艺的人形控制提供了强大的先验信息，但如何有效将这些先验迁移至感知驱动的物体交互仍具挑战性。为攻克这一瓶颈，我们提出一个框架，将近期提出的生成式预训练控制器（GPC）从通用人体运动扩展至全身人形-环境交互。首先，我们将GPC适配为以场景可供性线索和特权状态信息为条件的交互专家。这些专家在利用预训练人体运动先验的同时，学习任务特定的接触行为，包括伸向物体、抓取环境支撑物以保持稳定，以及推动可移动物体。其次，我们引入一个感知驱动的学生模型，该模型保留预训练GPC策略，并利用机载感官观测从专家处蒸馏交互技能。为弥合特权专家观测与感官输入之间的差距，我们提出两个互补的训练目标，使预训练运动先验在蒸馏过程中得以有效适应。值得注意的是，我们在多个全身交互任务上的实验表明，大规模生成式人体运动先验为在富含接触的真实环境中学习可部署的人形交互策略提供了有效基础。

title: OpenWAM: An Open Framework for Composable World-Action Models
summary: World-action models (WAMs) couple future prediction with robot control, yet existing systems often vary the video backbone, interaction structure, supervision, and inference procedure simultaneously, making their design choices difficult to compare. We introduce OPENWAM, an open world-action modeling framework built around a common causal robot-video foundation and configurable video-action interaction. Starting from Wan2.2-5B, we perform causal robot-video pretraining on over 10,000 hours of video, then integrate an action expert through a shared Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that supports joint, video-then-action, action-then-video, and decoupled generation. OPENWAM achieves high success rates on four LIBERO suites and real-world bimanual tasks; robot-video training with causal adaptation improves VTA success on LIBERO-Long from 68.4% to 97.8%. The same configurable architecture naturally extends to inverse and forward dynamics, allowing us to study how counterfactual transitions improve independently trained dynamics models beyond demonstrations alone. When only the video predictor is adapted to a new task, a frozen local-context inverse dynamics model trained on counterfactual data and demonstrations achieves 84.0% mean success across four held-out LIBERO-90 tasks, compared with 47.0% for a full-context inverse model and 21.5% for a local-context model trained only on demonstrations. For forward dynamics, counterfactual supervision reduces RGB prediction error by 34.5% and raises outcome identification from 21.1% to 71.3% among 16 same-state outcomes. OPENWAM provides a common testbed for comparing WAM interaction designs and for studying dynamics learning from video data beyond successful demonstrations.
tldr: OpenWAM is an open framework for composable world-action models, built on causal robot-video pretraining and a configurable Mixture-of-Transformers architecture, demonstrating strong performance on LIBERO suites and real-world bimanual tasks while enabling systematic study of video-action interaction designs and dynamics learning from counterfactual data.
tldr_zh: OpenWAM是一个用于可组合世界动作模型的开放框架，基于因果机器人视频预训练和可配置的Transformer混合架构，在LIBERO套件和真实世界双手任务上表现出色，并支持对视频-动作交互设计和反事实动力学学习的系统研究。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs）将未来预测与机器人控制相结合，然而现有系统往往同时改变视频主干网络、交互结构、监督方式和推理流程，使得其设计选择难以进行公平比较。我们提出OPENWAM，一个开放的世界-动作建模框架，基于统一的因果机器人-视频基础模型和可配置的视频-动作交互机制构建。以Wan2.2-5B为起点，我们在超过10，000小时的视频数据上进行因果机器人-视频预训练，随后通过共享的混合Transformer架构集成动作专家模块，该架构支持联合生成、先视频后动作、先动作后视频以及解耦生成四种模式。OPENWAM在四个LIBERO基准套件和真实世界双臂任务上均取得了较高的成功率；结合因果自适应的机器人-视频训练将LIBERO-Long上的VTA成功率从68.4%提升至97.8%。这一可配置架构自然地扩展到逆动力学和正动力学建模，使我们能够研究反事实状态转移如何超越仅依赖示范数据来改进独立训练的动力学模型。当仅将视频预测器适配到新任务时，基于反事实数据和示范训练的冻结局部上下文逆动力学模型在四个保留的LIBERO-90任务上实现了84.0%的平均成功率，而全上下文逆模型为47.0%，仅使用示范训练的局部上下文模型为21.5%。在正动力学方面，反事实监督将RGB预测误差降低了34.5%，并在16个同状态结果中使结果识别准确率从21.1%提升至71.3%。OPENWAM为比较WAM交互设计以及研究超越成功示范的视频数据动力学学习提供了一个通用测试平台。

title: ESP: Energy-Score Policy for One-Step Multimodal Action Generation
summary: Generative action models based on diffusion and flow matching have been increasingly adopted in vision-language-action (VLA) policies for their ability to capture diverse behaviors, including multiple valid action sequences under the same observation and instruction. Their iterative sampling procedures, however, require repeated network evaluations to generate each action chunk, increasing inference latency in closed-loop control. We propose ESP (Energy-Score Policy), a teacher-free approach that maps policy context and noise directly to an action chunk in a single network evaluation. ESP trains the action head with the energy score rather than mean squared error. Whereas squared-error regression targets the conditional mean, the energy score is strictly proper: its expected value is uniquely minimized by the target distribution. This provides a principled objective for learning multimodal action distributions without iterative sampling, with exact recovery at the population optimum when the model can represent the target distribution. Experiments on both simulation and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate competitive task success with substantially lower action-generation latency than the flow matching baseline. These results support direct distributional learning as an efficient alternative to iterative generative robot policies.
tldr: ESP introduces a teacher-free, one-step action generation method for VLA policies using the energy score as a strictly proper training objective, removing iterative sampling and reducing inference latency while maintaining task success in simulation and real-robot manipulation.
tldr_zh: ESP提出了一种基于能量分数的无教师单步动作生成方法，用于VLA策略，通过严格适当的训练目标替代迭代采样，在保持任务成功率的同时显著降低推理延迟。
summary_zh: 基于扩散和流匹配的生成式动作模型，因其能够捕捉多样化行为（包括在同一观察和指令下多种有效的动作序列）而被越来越多地应用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中。然而，其迭代采样过程需要对每个动作块进行多次网络评估，从而增加了闭环控制中的推理延迟。我们提出ESP（能量得分策略），一种无需教师模型的方案，通过单次网络评估将策略上下文和噪声直接映射为动作块。ESP使用能量得分而非均方误差来训练动作头。均方误差回归针对的是条件均值，而能量得分是严格适当的：其期望值唯一地被目标分布最小化。这为无需迭代采样即可学习多模态动作分布提供了原则性目标，并且在模型能表示目标分布时，可在总体最优处实现精确恢复。在仿真和真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，与流匹配基线相比，ESP在实现竞争性任务成功率的同时，显著降低了动作生成延迟。这些结果支持直接分布学习作为迭代生成式机器人策略的高效替代方案。

title: QF3: Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients
summary: Flow policies have become a standard policy class for learning robot behaviors from demonstrations, but reinforcement learning is still critical for improving pre-trained flow policies or learning them from scratch through interaction. We introduce QF3 (Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients), an online off-policy RL algorithm that trains a flow policy with flow matching plus the critic's action gradient, backpropagated through a one-step prediction of the flow's output. To keep updates where the critic and this prediction are reliable, QF3 applies the critic gradient only to action dimensions that stay near the replay action. To our knowledge, QF3 is the first off-policy flow RL method to train humanoid locomotion policies from scratch and transfer them zero-shot to hardware. Paired with a high-throughput off-policy training recipe, it trains humanoid locomotion and motion-tracking policies with a 10x wall-clock speedup over FPO++, a recent on-policy flow RL method. We further apply QF3 to fine-tune pretrained flow-based manipulation policies on both ABC-Sim and Robomimic tasks. These results suggest that QF3 can both learn robot policies from scratch and refine those acquired from demonstrations. Website: https://qf3-rl.github.io/
tldr: QF3 is a novel off-policy reinforcement learning algorithm that trains flow policies using filtered critic action gradients, achieving fast humanoid locomotion learning from scratch with zero-shot hardware transfer and a 10x speedup over prior on-policy methods, as well as effective fine-tuning of pretrained manipulation policies.
tldr_zh: QF3是一种新颖的离策略强化学习算法，通过使用过滤后的评论家动作梯度训练流策略，实现了从零开始快速学习人形机器人运动策略并零样本迁移到硬件，相比现有方法快10倍，并能有效微调预训练的操纵策略。
summary_zh: 流策略已成为从示范中学习机器人行为的标准策略类别，但强化学习对于改进预训练的流策略或通过交互从头学习仍至关重要。我们提出QF3（带过滤Q梯度的快速流强化学习），一种在线离策略强化学习算法，通过流匹配结合评论家的动作梯度来训练流策略，该梯度通过流输出的一步预测进行反向传播。为了确保更新发生在评论家及其预测可靠的区域，QF3仅将评论家梯度应用于保持在回放动作附近的动作维度。据我们所知，QF3是首个从零训练人形运动策略并零样本迁移至硬件的离策略流强化学习方法。结合高吞吐量的离策略训练方案，它训练人形运动和运动跟踪策略的墙钟速度比FPO++（一种最近的在线策略流强化学习方法）快10倍。我们进一步将QF3应用于ABC-Sim和Robomimic任务上预训练流操作策略的微调。这些结果表明，QF3既能从零学习机器人策略，也能优化从示范中获得的策略。网站：https://qf3-rl.github.io/

title: PhoneBot: A Low-Cost Open Humanoid Robot Platform Reusing Smartphones
summary: The adoption of humanoid robots in education and research remains limited by high hardware costs, complex sensing systems, and substantial computational requirements. This paper presents PhoneBot, a low-cost, open-source humanoid robot platform that repurposes commodity smartphones as its primary sensing and computing unit. By using a smartphone's integrated inertial measurement unit (IMU), camera, wireless connectivity, and onboard processing capabilities, PhoneBot reduces hardware costs and simplifies the system architecture. The robot combines a modular lower-body structure driven by 13 low-cost actuators with a torso-mounted smartphone that supports perception, control computation, and user interaction. We describe the mechanical design, software architecture, and real-time communication framework that support stable locomotion and capabilities including vision-based human following, conversational interaction, filming, and mobile telepresence. Experimental evaluations demonstrate reliable walking, perception-driven interaction, and straightforward deployment using off-the-shelf consumer smartphones. With fully open-source hardware and software designs, PhoneBot provides an affordable, reproducible platform for education, research, and rapid prototyping. More details are available at https://phonebot.dev.
tldr: PhoneBot is a low-cost, open-source humanoid robot platform that repurposes commodity smartphones as its sensing and computing unit, enabling stable locomotion and perception-driven interactions for education and research.
tldr_zh: PhoneBot是一个低成本、开源的人形机器人平台，利用商用智能手机作为感知和计算单元，实现稳定行走和感知驱动的交互，适用于教育和研究。
summary_zh: 人形机器人在教育和研究领域的应用仍受限于高昂的硬件成本、复杂的传感系统以及大量的计算需求。本文介绍了PhoneBot，一种低成本、开源的人形机器人平台，该平台将商用智能手机重新用作其主要的感知与计算单元。通过利用智能手机内置的惯性测量单元（IMU）、摄像头、无线连接功能及板载处理能力，PhoneBot降低了硬件成本并简化了系统架构。该机器人将模块化下肢结构与躯干安装的智能手机相结合，其中下肢由13个低成本执行器驱动，而智能手机则支持感知、控制计算及用户交互。我们描述了支撑稳定运动及视觉人体跟随、对话交互、拍摄和移动远程临场等能力的机械设计、软件架构和实时通信框架。实验评估表明，该系统能够利用现成的消费级智能手机实现可靠的行走、感知驱动的交互及便捷部署。凭借完全开源的硬件和软件设计，PhoneBot为教育、研究和快速原型开发提供了一个经济实惠、可复现的平台。更多详情请访问https://phonebot.dev。

title: Magnet-Aware Control of Legged Robots
summary: Autonomous robots can increase uptime and reduce human exposure in Big Science facilities, but strong magnetic fields needed for their operation corrupt sensors and induce pose-dependent mechanical wrenches that destabilize robots and challenge conventional reactive controllers. This paper presents a control framework for modeling, estimating, and dynamically compensating for spatially varying magnetic wrenches acting on legged robots to improve robustness in these fields. We introduce a custom physics plugin for the MuJoCo simulator to model magnetic forces on rigid-body elements, alongside an inverse field-estimation framework to infer the latent magnetic field directly from quadruped dynamic responses and any number of sensor readings. Furthermore, we develop a Magnet-Aware Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Whole-Body Control (WBC) architecture that predicts and counteracts magnetic perturbations during locomotion to increase the range of magnetic fields in which the robot can operate. The effectiveness of the framework is validated through both simulation and physical hardware experiments. We show our method increases the the maximum rejectable disturbances from magnetic field in the force space by a factor of 2.5 and and between 1.6-2 times in torque space compared to a non-compensated system. Within the proposed magnetic field, this constitutes an increase in the area in which the robot can operate by 29,34% of which 10,84% would have previously caused an immediate collapse to non-compensated controllers.
tldr: This paper introduces a control framework for legged robots operating in strong magnetic fields, modeling magnetic wrenches and compensating for them via MPC and WBC, improving locomotion robustness in such environments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于在强磁场中运行的四足机器人的控制框架，通过建模和补偿磁力扰动，提高了机器人在此类环境下的运动鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 自主机器人能够提升大型科学设施的运行时间并减少人员暴露，但其运行所需的强磁场会干扰传感器，并引发与位姿相关的机械力矩，从而破坏机器人稳定性，对传统反应式控制器构成挑战。本文提出了一种控制框架，用于建模、估计并动态补偿足式机器人所受的空间变化磁场力矩，以增强其在该类环境中的鲁棒性。我们为MuJoCo仿真器引入了一个自定义物理插件，用于对刚体元件上的磁力进行建模，同时提出了一种逆场估计框架，可直接从四足机器人的动态响应及任意数量的传感器读数中推断潜在磁场。此外，我们开发了一种磁场感知的模型预测控制（MPC）与全身控制（WBC）架构，能够在运动过程中预测并抵消磁场扰动，从而扩大机器人可运行的磁场范围。该框架的有效性通过仿真与实际硬件实验得到了验证。结果表明，与未补偿系统相比，我们的方法在力空间中将可抑制的最大磁场扰动提升了2.5倍，在力矩空间中提升了1.6至2倍。在所提出的磁场条件下，机器人可运行面积增加了29.34%，其中10.84%的区域此前会导致未补偿控制器立即失效。

title: RIWANav: Recursive World-Action Models with Self-Improvement for Urban Navigation
summary: Long-horizon urban navigation requires sequential local decisions whose errors can compound over time. Imitation learning (IL) rarely learns from failures, while physical trial-and-error reinforcement learning (RL) is costly. Action-conditioned world models can provide imagined feedback by predicting visual consequences for candidate actions. However, a frozen world model may become less reliable as the policy evolves. In this paper, we introduce RIWANAV, a post-training framework that casts the coupled adaptation of a world model and an action model (policy) as task-specific recursive self-improvement (RSI). Each cycle alternates two updates. The world model evaluates policy actions through imagined outcomes, providing comparative feedback for group-relative policy optimization (GRPO). The improved policy then constructs a grounded self-curriculum, selecting expert-consistent action-video pairs by behavioral novelty and prediction error. The refined world model supplies feedback for the next policy update, closing the recursive self-improvement loop. Experiments show that RIWANAV outperforms training baselines and prior methods, validating the proposed recursive self-improvement loop between the policy and world model. Real-world trials further demonstrate its practical applicability.
tldr: RIWANAV proposes a recursive self-improvement framework that jointly adapts an action-conditioned world model and a policy for urban navigation, using imagined feedback for policy optimization and policy-driven data selection for world model refinement.
tldr_zh: RIWANAV 提出了一种递归自我改进框架，联合调整动作条件世界模型和策略用于城市导航，利用想象反馈进行策略优化，并通过策略驱动的数据选择来改进世界模型。
summary_zh: 长距离城市导航需要连续的局部决策，而这些决策的误差会随时间累积。模仿学习很少能从失败中学习，而物理试错强化学习成本高昂。基于动作的条件世界模型能够通过预测候选动作的视觉后果来提供想象中的反馈。然而，随着策略不断演进，冻结的世界模型可能变得不再可靠。本文提出了RIWANAV，一种训练后框架，将世界模型与动作模型（策略）的耦合自适应视为任务特定的递归自我改进过程。每个循环交替执行两种更新。世界模型通过想象的结果评估策略动作，为群体相对策略优化提供比较性反馈。改进后的策略随后构建基于实地的自我课程，通过行为新颖性和预测误差选择与专家一致的动作-视频对。精炼后的世界模型为下一次策略更新提供反馈，从而闭合递归自我改进的循环。实验表明，RIWANAV优于训练基线和现有方法，验证了策略与世界模型之间递归自我改进循环的有效性。真实世界试验进一步证明了其实用性。

title: Towards Efficient Robotic Manipulation Models with Self-Recursive Pruning
summary: Network pruning can reduce parameter redundancy in robotic policies. However, generic pruning criteria are tailored for image recognition tasks and commonly designed to preserve weight magnitude, local reconstruction, or language-model likelihood rather than closed-loop action behavior. Directly applying these pruning algorithms to robotic tasks yields unsatisfactory performance. In this paper, we propose Loss-Conditioned Activation-Moment (LCAM) pruning, a training-free method for unstructured pruning of pre-trained robotic manipulation policies. Specifically, we first rank connections using row-normalized weight contribution, activation moments measured on calibration demonstrations, and the sensitivity of output directions to the action-prediction loss. We further design a self-recursive coarse-to-fine procedure: importance is recalibrated after each nested coarse pruning stage, while held-out offline action distortion guides fine-grained budget allocation after a sparsity knee. Our algorithm is free from costly recovery training and simulator rollouts after pruning. Experiments on three LIBERO suites with competitive robotic policies, together with evaluations on OpenVLA, show that LCAM attains competitive performance across a broad range of pruning ratios. Notably, on LIBERO-Object with OpenVLA, our LCAM achieves 84.0% success at 50% unstructured pruning, retaining over 90% of the dense policy's success rate. Promising results on real-world robotic ping pong further demonstrate the effectiveness of our pruning algorithm.
tldr: This paper introduces LCAM, a training-free, unstructured pruning method for robotic manipulation policies that uses loss-conditioned activation moments and a self-recursive coarse-to-fine procedure to preserve closed-loop action behavior, achieving strong results on LIBERO benchmarks and OpenVLA without fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出LCAM，一种无需训练的机器人操作策略非结构化剪枝方法，利用损失条件下的激活矩和自递归粗到细流程保留闭环动作行为，在LIBERO基准和OpenVLA上取得优异性能且无需微调。
summary_zh: 网络剪枝能够减少机器人策略中的参数冗余。然而，通用剪枝准则通常针对图像识别任务设计，其目标多为保持权重幅值、局部重构能力或语言模型似然度，而非闭环动作行为。直接将这些剪枝算法应用于机器人任务，效果并不理想。本文提出一种基于损失条件的激活矩（Loss-Conditioned Activation-Moment, LCAM）剪枝方法，这是一种无需训练的非结构化剪枝技术，适用于预训练的机器人操作策略。具体而言，我们首先通过行归一化权重贡献、在标定示范上测得的激活矩，以及输出方向对动作预测损失的敏感性，对连接进行排序。此外，我们设计了一种自递归的由粗到细的流程：在每一次嵌套的粗剪枝阶段后重新校准重要性，而在稀疏拐点之后，由留出的离线动作失真度引导细粒度预算分配。该算法在剪枝后无需昂贵的恢复训练或模拟器 rollout。在三个LIBERO基准套件上的实验（使用具有竞争力的机器人策略）以及对OpenVLA的评估表明，LCAM在广泛的剪枝比率下均能达到具有竞争力的性能。值得注意的是，在LIBERO-Object上结合OpenVLA时，LCAM在50%非结构化剪枝下实现了84.0%的成功率，保留了密集策略成功率的90%以上。在真实机器人乒乓球任务上的优异结果进一步验证了我们剪枝算法的有效性。

title: WareFly-VLA: A Vision-Language-Action Framework for UAV Navigation and Human Tracking in Smart Warehouses
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have achieved impressive results in robotic manipulation and ground-mobile navigation, yet language-conditioned control of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in smart warehouses remains largely unexplored, hindered by the lack of benchmarks that jointly provide continuous low-level flight actions, fine-grained natural-language target descriptions, and realistic industrial environments. This paper introduces WareFly-VLA, a photorealistic UAV VLA framework and dataset for language-guided human search, localization, and tracking in warehouse environments. It contains 507 human-teleoperated flight episodes and 8,504 high-resolution RGB transitions collected in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, each paired with a human-written appearance description of the target worker and a synchronized four-degree-of-freedom control command. Two aerial tasks are covered: target approach and person following, under occlusion, long-range search, altitude variation, and clutter. A unified benchmark of four open-source VLA architectures (SmolVLA, GR00T N1.7, pi_0 and OpenVLA) is established under a leakage-free episode-level protocol at two control rates. The results show that language-conditioned aerial control in warehouses is far from solved: performance drops substantially under strict generalization settings, continuous action modeling consistently outperforms discrete action tokenization, only the forward channel is reliably learnable from a single frame, and current foundation-model interfaces transfer poorly from ground and humanoid embodiments to aerial platforms. The synchronized video, language, action, pose, and difficulty annotations further support world-model research. The dataset, baselines, and evaluation protocol are released to support language-grounded aerial autonomy in smart warehouses.
tldr: WareFly-VLA introduces a photorealistic UAV vision-language-action (VLA) framework and dataset for language-guided human search and tracking in smart warehouses, benchmarking four VLA architectures and revealing that language-conditioned aerial control remains challenging, especially under strict generalization settings.
tldr_zh: WareFly-VLA 提出了一个用于智能仓库中语言引导的无人机人类搜索与跟踪的逼真 VLA 框架和数据集，并对四种 VLA 架构进行了基准测试，揭示了在严格泛化设置下语言条件空中控制的挑战。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作和地面移动导航领域取得了显著成果，然而，在智能仓库中，基于语言条件控制的无人机（UAV）仍鲜有探索，其障碍在于缺乏同时提供连续低层级飞行动作、细粒度自然语言目标描述以及真实工业环境的基准测试集。本文提出了WareFly-VLA，一个面向仓库环境中语言引导的人员搜索、定位与跟踪任务的逼真无人机VLA框架及数据集。该数据集包含在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中采集的507段人工遥操作飞行片段和8，504帧高分辨率RGB转换图像，每帧均配有对目标工人的手写外观描述及同步的四自由度控制指令。数据集涵盖两项空中任务：目标接近与人员跟随，并涉及遮挡、远距离搜索、高度变化和杂乱场景。本文在无泄漏的片段级协议下，以两种控制频率对四种开源VLA架构（SmolVLA、GR00T N1.7、pi_0和OpenVLA）建立了统一基准。结果表明，仓库环境中的语言条件空中控制远未得到解决：在严格的泛化设置下性能显著下降；连续动作建模始终优于离散动作分词；仅前向通道可从单帧中可靠学习；当前基础模型接口从地面和人形本体向空中平台的迁移效果不佳。同步的视频、语言、动作、姿态及难度标注进一步支持了世界模型研究。数据集、基线模型及评估协议已公开，以支持智能仓库中的语言 grounded 空中自主性研究。

title: Behavioral Safety Assessment towards Large-scale Deployment of Autonomous Vehicles, Part II: Assessment Results
summary: Third-party evaluations of autonomous vehicle (AV) safety can play a vital role in improving public acceptance, building consumer confidence, and establishing effective safety standards. In Part I of this study, we propose a dedicated third-party testing initiative for systematically evaluating AV behavioral safety. In this paper, we validate our proposed framework using Autoware.Universe, an open-source Level 4 Automated Driving System (ADS), tested both in simulated environments and on the physical test track at the University of Michigan's Mcity Testing Facility. The results indicate that Autoware.Universe possesses 6 out of 14 behavioral competencies and exhibited a crash rate of 3.01x10^-3 crashes per mile, approximately 1,000 times higher than the average human driver crash rate. During the tests, we also uncovered a number of unknown unsafe scenarios for Autoware.Universe. These findings underscore the necessity of behavioral safety evaluations for improving AV safety performance prior to widespread public deployment.
tldr: This paper validates a third-party behavioral safety assessment framework for autonomous vehicles using Autoware.Universe in simulation and on a physical test track, finding it possesses only 6 of 14 behavioral competencies and a crash rate roughly 1000 times higher than human drivers.
tldr_zh: 本文通过仿真和实体测试轨道上的Autoware.Universe验证了第三方自动驾驶行为安全评估框架，发现其仅具备14项行为能力中的6项，碰撞率约为人类驾驶员的1000倍。
summary_zh: 第三方对自动驾驶车辆安全性的评估在提升公众接受度、增强消费者信心以及建立有效安全标准方面发挥着至关重要的作用。在本研究的第一部分中，我们提出了一项专门的第三方测试计划，用于系统评估自动驾驶车辆的行为安全性。本文利用Autoware.Universe（一个开源的四级自动驾驶系统）在仿真环境和密歇根大学Mcity测试设施的实体测试跑道上验证了所提框架。结果表明，Autoware.Universe具备14项行为能力中的6项，其碰撞率为每英里3.01×10^-3次，约为人类驾驶员平均碰撞率的1000倍。测试过程中，我们还发现了Autoware.Universe存在若干未知的不安全场景。这些发现强调了在广泛部署于公共领域之前，进行行为安全评估对于提升自动驾驶车辆安全性能的必要性。

title: ActTune: Action-Aware Precision and GPU Operating-Point Adaptation for Energy-Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies repeatedly invoke inference to control robots, making graphics processing unit (GPU) energy a recurring cost of task execution. Reducing energy per inference call, however, may not reduce energy per successful task if numerical errors increase failures or slower inference prolongs execution. We therefore target GPU energy per successful task while preserving task success and keeping the inference-latency increase within 10\%. Our approach builds on two observations: quantization sensitivity varies across action classes, model layers, and weights versus activations; and numerical precision changes the workload, shifting favorable GPU operating points. We introduce ActTune, an action-aware framework that connects layer-wise precision allocation with workload-dependent GPU operating-point selection over requested frequency--power-cap pairs. A lightweight decision tree learns its splits and leaf precision configurations directly from configuration action errors, then selects precision before each policy call. The controller forecasts the next workload and applies the selected GPU operating point asynchronously using a lookup table calibrated under a latency budget. A shared resident quantized weight bank enables configuration switching without weight reconstruction or additional policy evaluations. On LIBERO, a benchmark for lifelong robot learning, ActTune improves mean task success by up to 2.3\% relative to state of the art. Relative to the original BF16 implementations, it delivers up to $2.02\times$ faster inference and, with GPU operating-point adaptation, reduces energy per successful task by up to 76.8\%.
tldr: ActTune introduces an action-aware framework that adapts layer-wise precision and GPU operating points to reduce energy per successful task for VLA inference, achieving up to 76.8% energy reduction and 2.02x speedup on LIBERO while preserving task success.
tldr_zh: ActTune 提出了一种动作感知框架，通过调整层精度和 GPU 工作点来降低 VLA 推理每个成功任务的能耗，在 LIBERO 上实现高达 76.8% 的能耗降低和 2.02 倍的加速，同时保持任务成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通过反复调用推理来控制机器人，使得图形处理单元（GPU）能耗成为任务执行中的一项持续开销。然而，如果数值误差导致失败率上升，或推理速度变慢延长了执行时间，那么降低单次推理调用的能耗并不一定能降低每项成功任务的能耗。因此，我们在保证任务成功率并保持推理延迟增幅在10\%以内的前提下，以每项成功任务的GPU能耗为优化目标。我们的方法基于两个观察：量化敏感性在动作类别、模型层以及权重与激活之间各不相同；数值精度改变计算负载，从而改变GPU的有利工作点。我们提出ActTune，一种动作感知框架，将逐层精度分配与依赖于负载的GPU工作点选择（基于请求的频率-功耗上限组合）相结合。轻量级决策树直接从配置的动作误差中学习其分裂规则和叶节点精度配置，并在每次策略调用前选择精度。控制器预测下一段负载，并通过在延迟预算下标定的查找表异步应用所选的GPU工作点。共享的常驻量化权重库使得配置切换无需权重重建或额外的策略评估。在终身机器人学习基准LIBERO上，ActTune相较现有最先进方法将平均任务成功率提升了最高2.3\%。相较于原始的BF16实现，其推理速度最高提升$2.02\times$，并结合GPU工作点自适应，每项成功任务的能耗最高降低76.8\%。

title: Safe Multi-Robot Collaborative Transport Using Density Functions
summary: This paper presents a hierarchical density-based model predictive control framework for safe collaborative manipulation by multiple quadrupedal robots. The framework enables a team of robots to push a shared object to a desired pose using only the initial and goal poses, without requiring a precomputed reference trajectory. A centralized box-level MPC optimizes contact forces while enforcing a control-density constraint for goal convergence and obstacle avoidance. Each robot then solves its own distributed robot-level whole-body MPC, under a stated shared-information assumption, to track its moving contact location while accounting for static obstacles and the time-varying positions of neighboring robots. The approach is evaluated in MuJoCo using whole-body contact dynamics for two and three Unitree Go2 quadrupeds collaboratively pushing rigid objects through narrow passages. Comparisons with matched Control Barrier Function and RRT* based tracking baselines demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed density-based formulation for push-only, force- and torque-coupled manipulation tasks. Implementation videos are available at https://jaggu2606.github.io/go2-density-mpc-pushing/
tldr: This paper presents a hierarchical density-based MPC framework for safe collaborative transport of objects by multiple quadrupedal robots, evaluated in simulation and compared against CBF and RRT* baselines.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于密度的分层模型预测控制框架，用于多四足机器人的安全协作搬运，并在仿真中与CBF和RRT*基线进行了比较。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于分层密度模型预测控制框架，用于多台四足机器人安全协同操作。该框架使机器人团队仅利用初始位姿和目标位姿，即可将共享物体推至期望位姿，无需预设参考轨迹。中央箱级模型预测控制优化接触力，同时施加控制密度约束，以实现目标收敛与避障。随后，每台机器人在既定的共享信息假设下，独立求解其分布式机器人级全身模型预测控制，以跟踪移动接触位置，并同时考虑静态障碍物及邻近机器人的时变位置。该方法在MuJoCo环境中，利用全身接触动力学，对两台及三台Unitree Go2四足机器人协作推动刚性物体穿越狭窄通道的场景进行了评估。与匹配的控制障碍函数及基于RRT*的跟踪基线方法的对比结果表明，所提出的基于密度的方法在纯推、力与力矩耦合操作任务中具有有效性。实现视频见https://jaggu2606.github.io/go2-density-mpc-pushing/。

title: From Legs to Wheels: Embodiment-Aware Human Motion Retargeting for Mobile-Base Humanoids
summary: Human video offers a scalable source of robot demonstrations, yet most human-to-humanoid retargeting methods assume a legged robot with human-like kinematics. This assumption does not hold for mobile-base humanoids equipped with a wheeled base, vertical lift, and two arms. Human walking must be expressed through base motion, while torso bending may require coordinated lift and arm motion. We address this mismatch with a task-conditioned framework that assigns reconstructed human motion to base, lift, and arm responsibilities before robot-specific realization. The allocator preserves the human-derived path, stabilizes heading, separates turn and translation when needed, retimes commands to satisfy base limits, and repairs lift and arm trajectories. A deployment adapter then converts the reference to 50 Hz commands using stationary-base detection, deadband and slew-rate filtering, time-consistent playback scaling, and separate linear and angular gains. We evaluate the resulting references with human-derived task-space comparisons, policy-free simulation replay, and a qualitative execution on a physical robot.
tldr: The paper proposes a task-conditioned framework to retarget human motion from videos to mobile-base humanoids with wheeled base, vertical lift, and arms, addressing the kinematic mismatch by allocating motion responsibilities and adding a deployment adapter for real-robot execution.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种任务条件框架，将来自视频的人体运动重定向到具有轮式底座、垂直升降和手臂的移动底座人形机器人，通过分配运动责任并添加部署适配器来解决运动学不匹配问题。
summary_zh: 人类视频为机器人示范提供了可扩展的来源，然而大多数从人类到人形机器人的重定向方法假设其腿部机器人具有类人的运动学特性。这一假设对于配备轮式底座、垂直升降机构和双臂的移动底座人形机器人并不成立。人类行走必须通过底座运动来表达，而躯干弯曲则可能需要升降机构与手臂运动的协调配合。针对这一不匹配问题，我们提出了一种任务条件化框架，在机器人具体实现之前，将重建的人类运动分配到底座、升降机构和手臂各自的职责中。该分配器保留人类运动衍生的路径，稳定航向，在需要时将转弯与平移分离，重新定时命令以满足底座限制，并修复升降机构与手臂的运动轨迹。随后，部署适配器通过静止底座检测、死区与速率限制滤波、时间一致的播放缩放以及独立的线性和角向增益，将参考指令转换为50 Hz的命令。我们通过源自人类的任务空间对比、无策略仿真回放以及在物理机器人上的定性执行来评估所生成的参考指令。

title: How Much Planning Is Enough? Reducing Search and Computation in World-Model Planning
summary: Visual world models enable goal-directed control through decision-time action search, but their deployment efficiency is often limited by conservatively large planning budgets. We show that competitive task performance can be achieved without agreement with the Full-budget action, that sufficient budgets vary across model--task pairs, and that iterative planners repeatedly encode solve-invariant context. To address these inefficiencies, we propose {SufficientPlan}, a simple deployment framework that requires no modification to pretrained world models or planner updates. Its {Paired Sequential Budget Certification (PSBC)} component uses paired closed-loop evidence to search for and certify a reduced model--task-specific budget within a predefined Full-performance tolerance. Its {Static-Context Reuse (SCR)} component caches observation and goal representations across search iterations while preserving candidate-dependent planning and selected actions. Experiments across multiple world-model backbones and visual-control tasks show that SufficientPlan substantially reduces search budgets and planning latency while maintaining competitive control performance.
tldr: This paper proposes SufficientPlan, a deployment framework that reduces search budgets and planning latency for visual world-model-based goal-directed control by certifying reduced planning budgets and caching static context, without modifying the pretrained world model or planner.
tldr_zh: 本文提出SufficientPlan，一种部署框架，通过认证缩减的规划预算和缓存静态上下文，在不修改预训练世界模型或规划器的情况下，降低视觉世界模型目标导向控制的搜索预算和规划延迟。
summary_zh: 视觉世界模型通过决策时的动作搜索实现目标导向控制，但其部署效率常受制于保守的大规模规划预算。我们发现，在不与全预算动作保持一致的情况下，也能实现具有竞争力的任务性能；各模型-任务组合所需的充足预算差异显著；且迭代规划器会重复编码与求解无关的上下文信息。针对这些低效问题，我们提出了{SufficientPlan}，一个无需修改预训练世界模型或更新规划器的简洁部署框架。其{配对序列预算认证（PSBC）}组件利用配对闭环证据，在预定义全性能容差范围内搜索并认证缩减后的模型-任务特定预算；其{静态上下文复用（SCR）}组件在搜索迭代间缓存观测与目标表示，同时保留依赖候选的规划与所选动作。在多种世界模型骨干网络和视觉控制任务上的实验表明，SufficientPlan在保持竞争性控制性能的同时，显著减少了搜索预算与规划延迟。

title: Event-Driven Proactive Robot Assistance through Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Assistance in collaborative manipulation is often initiated by user instructions, making high-level reasoning request-driven. In fluent human teamwork, however, partners often infer the next helpful step from the observed outcome of an action rather than waiting for instructions. Motivated by this, we investigate an event-driven formulation of proactive assistance, where human--object interaction outcomes initiate assistive reasoning without user-provided task specifications at inference time. To this end, we propose an event-driven framework that monitors workspace state changes with an event monitor and, upon event completion, extracts stabilized pre/post snapshots that characterize the resulting state transition. A frozen pretrained Vision-Language Model (VLM) then uses its semantic priors to infer the task context, decide whether assistance is appropriate, and, when needed, generate a sequence of assistive actions from the observed transition. To make outputs executable and verifiable, we restrict actions to a set of action primitives and reference objects via integer IDs.We evaluate the same framework across three distinct real world tabletop collaboration tasks without task-specific training or fine-tuning. The event-driven framework achieves performance comparable to variants given user instructions.
tldr: The paper proposes an event-driven framework for proactive robot assistance that uses a frozen VLM to infer task context and generate assistive actions from observed human-object interaction outcomes, without user instructions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种事件驱动的主动辅助机器人框架，利用冻结的视觉-语言模型从观察到的人-物交互结果中推断任务上下文并生成辅助动作，无需用户指令。
summary_zh: 在协作操控中，辅助行为通常由用户指令触发，使得高层推理依赖于请求驱动。然而，在流畅的人机团队协作中，伙伴往往通过观察某个动作的结果来推断下一步的助益行为，而非等待指令。受此启发，我们研究了一种事件驱动的主动辅助形式，在该形式中，人-物交互结果在推理时无需用户提供任务规格即可启动辅助推理。为此，我们提出一个事件驱动框架，通过事件监控器监测工作区状态变化，并在事件完成后提取表征状态转移的稳定前后快照。随后，一个冻结的预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）利用其语义先验推断任务上下文，判断辅助是否合适，并在必要时根据观察到的状态转移生成一系列辅助动作。为使输出可执行且可验证，我们将动作限制在一组动作原语中，并通过整数ID引用对象。我们在三个不同的真实桌面协作任务中评估了同一框架，无需任务特定训练或微调。实验结果表明，该事件驱动框架在性能上与接收用户指令的变体相当。

title: Humanoid Horizon: Extending Task Horizon in Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation via Parallel Training, Dynamic Starting, and Reward Gating
summary: Cluttered indoor environments, where large and heavy objects are scattered across diverse surfaces, require humanoid robots to sequentially navigate, grasp, transport, and accurately place each item at its target location within a single uninterrupted episode. This long-horizon, whole-body loco-manipulation task remains a significant challenge for current methods. Previous approaches often suffer from two main issues: easy-reward bias, where training overemphasizes early transport stages at the expense of later ones, and catastrophic forgetting, where focusing on later stages leads to a decline in earlier-stage performance. In this work, we introduce Humanoid Horizon, a unified policy framework designed to overcome these limitations through three interrelated mechanisms. The Parallel Training Strategy organizes $N$ scenes into $S$ concurrent stage streams governed by a shared policy, ensuring all transport stages receive continuous gradient updates and removing the bottleneck of sequential optimization. The Dynamic Starting Mechanism updates each environment's initial state with terminal states from upstream rollouts, gradually broadening transition coverage and enhancing robustness at stage boundaries. Reward Gating sets the reward to zero for the rest of the episode in later-stage streams when the immediately preceding object is displaced beyond a set threshold, so the shared policy learns not to disturb a just-placed object and earlier placements are preserved throughout the episode. Collectively, these strategies achieve per-stage success rates exceeding 80\% on the two-object LHM-Humanoid benchmark (350 training scenes, 66 held-out scenes). As the number of sequentially transported objects grows beyond two, success declines with the horizon, but the degradation is graceful relative to the sharp drop seen in all baselines.
tldr: This paper presents Humanoid Horizon, a unified policy framework for long-horizon whole-body loco-manipulation in humanoid robots, using parallel training, dynamic starting, and reward gating to mitigate easy-reward bias and catastrophic forgetting, achieving high per-stage success rates on the LHM-Humanoid benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Humanoid Horizon，一种用于人形机器人长视野全身移动操作任务的统一策略框架，通过并行训练、动态起始和奖励门控机制来缓解易奖偏置和灾难性遗忘问题，在LHM-Humanoid基准上取得了较高的各阶段成功率。
summary_zh: 杂乱室内环境中，大型重型物体散布在不同表面上，要求人形机器人在一次不间断的任务片段中依次完成导航、抓取、搬运并精确地将每个物品放置到目标位置。这项长时间跨度、全身移动操作任务对现有方法而言仍是重大挑战。以往方法常面临两个主要问题：一是易得奖励偏差，即训练过度强调早期搬运阶段而忽视后期阶段；二是灾难性遗忘，即专注于后期阶段导致早期阶段表现下降。在本研究中，我们提出Humanoid Horizon——一个统一策略框架，通过三种相互关联的机制克服上述局限。并行训练策略将N个场景组织为S个由共享策略控制的同时进行的阶段流，确保所有搬运阶段持续获得梯度更新，消除了顺序优化的瓶颈。动态起始机制利用上游轨迹的终止状态更新每个环境的初始状态，逐渐扩展状态转移覆盖范围，增强阶段边界处的鲁棒性。奖励门控机制在后续阶段流中，当紧邻前一个物体被移出设定阈值范围时，将该片段剩余部分的奖励设为零，从而使共享策略学会不干扰刚放置的物体，并确保整个片段中早期放置得到保持。综合来看，这些策略在双物体LHM-Humanoid基准（350个训练场景，66个留出场景）上实现了超过80\%的各阶段成功率。当顺序搬运物体数量超过两个时，成功率随任务长度下降而降低，但相较于所有基线方法中出现的急剧下降，这种退化是平缓的。

title: Compact Robot Policies Need Fine-Grained Visual Representations
summary: Multi-task manipulation policies differ in architecture, scale, and pretrained priors all at once, so published comparisons cannot attribute performance to any single component. We argue that most of it comes from the visual representation, and that parameter scale and generative priors are largely incidental. To test this, we build CoRP (Compressed Representation Policy), a deliberately compact policy (48.9M parameters, no vision-language model and no video-generative prior) that factorizes into a representation extractor and a flow-matching action generator. It reaches 97.0% on LIBERO and 75.78%/73.36% on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Randomized, matching systems 40.9-163.6x larger. Holding the action generator fixed, we then vary one extractor property at a time. Pretrained initialization is decisive: a random ViT-S/14 drops to 78.1% and an ImageNet ResNet-34 to 74.5% on LIBERO. Pretraining alone is not enough, as freezing the encoder costs 19.8 points. Compression matters as much: resampling each view to 48 tokens beats passing all patch tokens (97.0% vs 83.2%), and a variational information bottleneck over those tokens is worse than a hard token budget, cutting LIBERO-Goal from 95.8% to 33.0% by suppressing the instruction-dependent token selection the policy relies on. Language conditioning contributes only where the observation leaves the goal ambiguous (LIBERO-Goal: 9.2% to 95.8%), while on RoboTwin 2.0, where observations are unambiguous, removing it slightly improves success. Therefore, we argue that a compact policy works when its representation is pretrained, task-adapted, and compressed. Project page: https://corp-policy.github.io/
tldr: This paper introduces CoRP, a compact 48.9M-parameter manipulation policy that achieves strong performance on LIBERO and RoboTwin benchmarks by matching larger systems, and systematically ablates its design to show that pretrained, task-adapted, and compressed visual representations are the primary drivers of performance, not scale or generative priors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了CoRP，一个紧凑的48.9M参数操作策略，在LIBERO和RoboTwin基准上取得了与更大系统相当的性能，并通过系统的消融实验证明，预测练、任务适配和压缩的视觉表示是性能的主要驱动因素，而非模型规模或生成先验。
summary_zh: 多任务操控策略在架构、规模和预训练先验上往往同时存在差异，因此已发表的对比研究无法将性能差异归因于任何单一组件。我们认为，性能差异主要来自视觉表征，而参数规模和生成式先验在很大程度上是次要因素。为验证这一假设，我们构建了CoRP（压缩表征策略），一种刻意保持紧凑的策略模型（4890万参数，无视觉-语言模型，无视频生成先验），其结构分解为表征提取器和流匹配动作生成器两部分。该模型在LIBERO上达到97.0%的准确率，在RoboTwin 2.0 Clean/Randomized上分别达到75.78%和73.36%，与规模大40.9至163.6倍的系统性能相当。在固定动作生成器的前提下，我们逐一改变提取器的单一属性进行实验。预训练初始化具有决定性作用：随机初始化的ViT-S/14在LIBERO上性能降至78.1%，ImageNet预训练的ResNet-34降至74.5%。仅预训练并不足够，冻结编码器导致性能下降19.8个百分点。压缩同样至关重要：将每个视图重采样为48个token优于传递所有patch token（97.0%对比83.2%），而在这些token上施加变分信息瓶颈的效果劣于硬性token预算，导致LIBERO-Goal从95.8%降至33.0%，原因是其抑制了策略所依赖的基于指令的token选择机制。语言条件仅在观测无法明确目标时发挥作用（LIBERO-Goal：从9.2%提升至95.8%），而在RoboTwin 2.0中，由于观测本身已无歧义，移除语言条件反而略微提升了成功率。因此，我们认为紧凑策略在表征经过预训练、任务自适应和压缩的前提下即可有效工作。项目主页：https://corp-policy.github.io/

title: VLA-ACL: Action-Consistent Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve strong robotic manipulation performance but incur high computational costs from processing long token sequences at every control step, limiting real-time deployment. Visual token pruning offers a direct solution, as visual patches dominate the input sequence and contain considerable redundancy. Existing approaches, however, either rely on indirect training-free heuristics, such as attention scores and motion thresholds, or require costly fine-tuning of the base VLA model. We introduce VLA-ACL (Action Consistency Learning), which learns a lightweight visual token pruning policy through action-level supervision while keeping the base VLA model entirely frozen. The training objective encourages actions produced from pruned visual contexts to remain consistent with the full-context teacher, with ground-truth actions as auxiliary supervision. This directly ties token selection to its effect on the downstream control output. Experiments on LIBERO and real-world manipulation tasks show that VLA-ACL prunes up to 87.5% of visual tokens while retaining competitive performance, reduces computation by up to 75%, and achieves a 1.5x inference speedup. These results establish a stronger performance-efficiency trade-off than existing frozen-VLA pruning methods and demonstrate the value of action-level supervision for visual token selection. Code is available at https://github.com/du-owen/VLA-ACL.
tldr: VLA-ACL learns a lightweight visual token pruning policy for frozen Vision-Language-Action models by enforcing action consistency with the full-context teacher, achieving up to 87.5% token pruning and 1.5x inference speedup on LIBERO and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: VLA-ACL 通过在冻结的视觉-语言-动作模型上学习轻量级视觉令牌剪枝策略，并保证与全上下文教师模型的动作一致性，在 LIBERO 和真实世界任务中实现了高达 87.5% 的令牌剪枝和 1.5 倍推理加速。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作任务中表现出色，但每个控制步骤中处理长序列令牌会产生高昂的计算成本，限制了其实时部署能力。视觉令牌剪枝提供了一种直接的解决方案，因为视觉补丁在输入序列中占主导地位，且包含大量冗余信息。然而，现有方法要么依赖无需训练的间接启发式规则（如注意力分数和运动阈值），要么需要对基础VLA模型进行昂贵的微调。我们提出了VLA-ACL（动作一致性学习），该方法通过动作级监督学习一种轻量级的视觉令牌剪枝策略，同时保持基础VLA模型完全冻结。训练目标鼓励从剪枝后的视觉上下文生成的动作与完整上下文的教师模型保持一致，并以真实动作作为辅助监督信号。这直接将令牌选择与下游控制输出的影响联系起来。在LIBERO和真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，VLA-ACL可剪除高达87.5%的视觉令牌，同时保持具有竞争力的性能，计算量减少最高达75%，推理速度提升1.5倍。这些结果在性能-效率权衡上优于现有的冻结VLA剪枝方法，并验证了动作级监督在视觉令牌选择中的价值。代码可在 https://github.com/du-owen/VLA-ACL 获取。

title: Beyond Waypoint Regression: Query-Based Cost Learning over Reachable Ego Futures for End-to-End Driving
summary: End-to-end planners based on waypoint regression achieve strong open-loop accuracy, but they primarily learn to mimic expert geometry and remain difficult to adapt to deployment-time safety constraints. We propose a query-based cost-learning framework that estimates bounded costs for dynamically reachable ego trajectory queries, rather than dense BEV cells or a small regressed trajectory set. Compact joint scene tokens capture coherent multimodal agent futures, while contingency-aware cost aggregation and cost-guided intra-cluster MPPI mixing convert the learned cost topology into feasible ego plans. On nuScenes, our method improves over prior cost-estimation planners such as ST-P3 and NMP, outperforms most regression baselines in collision rate, while remaining competitive in L2, and retaining an interpretable cost interface. On real-world driving logs, the proposed planner reduces collision rates compared with SparseDrive and Alpamayo without fine-tuning, while maintaining a diverse set of candidate trajectories.
tldr: This paper proposes a query-based cost-learning framework for end-to-end driving that estimates bounded costs over dynamically reachable ego trajectories, improving collision rates while maintaining open-loop accuracy and interpretability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于查询的成本学习框架，用于端到端驾驶，通过对动态可达的自我轨迹进行成本估计，在保持开环准确性和可解释性的同时降低碰撞率。
summary_zh: 基于路点回归的端到端规划器在开环精度上表现出色，但其主要学习模仿专家几何轨迹，难以适应部署阶段的安全约束。为此，我们提出了一种基于查询的成本学习框架，用于对动态可达的自车轨迹查询进行有界成本估计，而非依赖密集的鸟瞰图网格或小型回归轨迹集合。紧凑的联合场景标记能够捕捉多模态智能体未来状态的一致性，而应急感知成本聚合与成本引导的簇内MPPI混合机制，则将学习到的成本拓扑转化为可行的自车规划方案。在nuScenes数据集上，我们的方法相较于ST-P3和NMP等先前的成本估计规划器，在碰撞率上优于大多数回归基线，同时在L2指标上保持竞争力，并保留了可解释的成本接口。在真实驾驶日志中，所提出的规划器无需微调即可在降低碰撞率方面优于SparseDrive和Alpamayo，同时保持候选轨迹的多样性。

title: AutodidactWAM: Cross-Modal Self-Distillation from Generated Video to Robot Actions
summary: World-action models (WAMs) such as Cosmos 3 jointly generate future video and robot actions from an observation and instruction. Adapting one such model with a lightweight LoRA fine-tune to a previously unseen robot, a Unitree G1 humanoid with five-fingered BrainCo hands, exposes a video-action asymmetry: the video renders plausible task executions, while the co-generated action is systematically mis-targeted. We evaluate closed-loop real-robot trials at three cumulative stages: pre-grasp, grasp, and pick-and-place. The native action succeeds only approximately 17%, 10%, and 7% of the time, respectively, and performs worse on held-out objects. We propose AutodidactWAM, a hand-pose estimator trained without teleoperation, followed by inverse kinematics, that runs on the model's generated video to recover action estimates. Paired with the native prediction, these recovered actions provide preferred targets for fine-tuning only the action-related layers, while the generated video is teacher-forced. We compare supervised relabeling with a rectified-flow adaptation of Diffusion-DPO. After one-time embodiment adaptation, self-distillation requires no additional task-specific teleoperation. The recovered-action gate reaches approximately 75%, 47%, and 42% pre-grasp, grasp, and pick-and-place success, compared with 17%, 10%, and 7% for the native action. A hybrid objective combining preference supervision, supervised target fitting, and Cartesian trajectory anchoring (DPO+SFT+DTW) performs best: on Oreo, the training object, it reaches 90% pre-grasp and 20% full-task success; on a held-out object, it reaches 80% and 30%. Plain Flow-DPO reaches 0% success despite 1.000 validation preference accuracy, indicating that the combination of training objectives, rather than the contrastive objective alone, drives the observed gains.
tldr: This paper introduces AutodidactWAM, a method that adapts a vision-language-action model to a new humanoid robot by using the model's own generated video to recover action estimates via a trained hand-pose estimator and inverse kinematics, then fine-tuning only action-related layers with a hybrid DPO+SFT+DTW objective, improving real-robot task success from ~17% to ~75% without teleoperation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出AutodidactWAM方法，通过手部姿态估计器和逆运动学从模型生成的视频中恢复动作，并结合DPO+SFT+DTW混合目标仅微调动作相关层，在无需遥操作的情况下将真实人形机器人的任务成功率从约17%提升至约75%。
summary_zh: 世界-动作模型（WAMs），如Cosmos 3，能够从观测和指令中联合生成未来视频和机器人动作。通过对这类模型进行轻量级LoRA微调，使其适配一台未曾见过的机器人——搭载五指BrainCo手的Unitree G1人形机器人——暴露出一种视频-动作不对称性：视频渲染出看似合理的任务执行过程，而协同生成的动作却系统性地出现目标偏移。我们在三个累积阶段评估了闭环真实机器人试验：预抓取、抓取和拾放。原生动作的成功率分别仅为约17%、10%和7%，且在未见过物体上表现更差。我们提出AutodidactWAM，一种无需遥操作训练的手部姿态估计器，结合逆运动学，运行于模型生成的视频之上以恢复动作估计。与原生预测配对后，这些恢复的动作仅用于微调动作相关层提供了优选目标，而生成的视频则采用教师强制方式。我们将监督重标注与基于整流流的Diffusion-DPO变体进行比较。经过一次性本体适配后，自蒸馏无需额外的任务专属遥操作。恢复动作门控在预抓取、抓取和拾放阶段的成功率分别达到约75%、47%和42%，而原生动作仅为17%、10%和7%。结合偏好监督、监督目标拟合和笛卡尔轨迹锚定的混合目标（DPO+SFT+DTW）表现最佳：在训练物体Oreo上，预抓取成功率达90%，完整任务成功率达20%；在未见物体上，分别达到80%和30%。纯Flow-DPO尽管验证偏好准确率达到1.000，但成功率仍为0%，这表明训练目标的组合而非对比目标本身，是驱动上述性能提升的关键因素。

title: IronMan: Information-Constrained Video-Action Learning for Robot Manipulation
summary: Video Action Models (VAMs) couple visual dynamics modeling with action generation for robot manipulation. However, video representations are not naturally suited to action generation, as exposing the action policy to excessive visual detail can impair its generalization ability. Therefore, we introduce IronMan (Information-constRained videO-actioN learning for robot MANipulation), a robust video-action learning framework built on the information bottleneck principle. The core principle of this framework is to impose information constraints that suppress irrelevant visual information while preserving action-relevant dynamics cues. IronMan employs a dynamics-aware bottleneck that distills noisy, entangled one-step video features into compact world representations. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate strong in-distribution (ID) performance and out-of-distribution (OOD) robustness while maintaining efficient inference. IronMan achieves success rates of 99.0% on LIBERO and 79.4% on RoboTwin clean2clean, outperforming all the evaluated baselines. Under OOD shifts, IronMan achieves a success rate of 79.1% on LIBERO-Plus, exceeding the strongest baseline by 10.4 percentage points. Project page: https://youngsoul0731.github.io/ironman-project-page/
tldr: IronMan introduces an information-constrained video-action learning framework for robot manipulation, using a dynamics-aware bottleneck to suppress irrelevant visual details and improve both in-distribution performance and out-of-distribution robustness.
tldr_zh: IronMan 提出了一种信息受限的视频-动作学习框架，用于机器人操作，通过动力学感知瓶颈抑制无关视觉细节，提升分布内性能和分布外鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 视频动作模型（VAMs）将视觉动态建模与动作生成相结合，用于机器人操控任务。然而，视频表示天然不适合直接用于动作生成，因为将动作策略暴露于过度的视觉细节会削弱其泛化能力。为此，我们提出IronMan（信息约束视频-动作学习框架，用于机器人操控），这是一个基于信息瓶颈原理构建的鲁棒视频-动作学习框架。该框架的核心原则是施加信息约束，以抑制与任务无关的视觉信息，同时保留与动作相关的动态线索。IronMan采用动态感知瓶颈，将含噪且纠缠的单步视频特征蒸馏为紧凑的世界表示。大量的仿真和真实世界实验表明，IronMan在分布内（ID）性能上表现优异，在分布外（OOD）场景下具有鲁棒性，同时保持高效的推理能力。IronMan在LIBERO上达到99.0%的成功率，在RoboTwin clean2clean上达到79.4%的成功率，优于所有评估的基线方法。在OOD偏移条件下，IronMan在LIBERO-Plus上取得79.1%的成功率，超出最强基线10.4个百分点。项目页面：https://youngsoul0731.github.io/ironman-project-page/

title: Commit While Futures Agree: Consequence-Aware Adaptive Action Chunking for Robot Manipulation
summary: Action-chunking policies predict multi-step control sequences, but a fundamental question remains: how much of a predicted action chunk should be committed before replanning? Existing systems typically execute a fixed-length prefix, implicitly assuming that the same execution horizon remains trustworthy across states. Some adaptive methods estimate this horizon from the similarity or stability of predicted actions. However, different actions may lead to the same successful outcome, whereas similar actions can produce different futures, suggesting that commitment should be determined by agreement among imagined futures rather than by similarity in action space. To this end, we propose Consequence-Aware Adaptive Action Chunking (CA$^3$C), an inference-time framework built on a simple principle: commit while imagined futures agree, and replan when they diverge. Without modifying or retraining the base policy, CA$^3$C uses an action-conditioned world model to imagine the future consequences of multiple candidate action chunks under the same sampling noise. Using these imagined consequences, we formulate execution-horizon estimation as a Bayesian change-point inference problem and select the execution candidate through future consensus. Across multiple simulation benchmarks and real-world robot manipulation tasks, CA$^3$C consistently improves diverse action-chunking policies, achieving up to a 71.8% relative reduction in failure rate over the corresponding base policies.
tldr: This paper introduces CA3C, an inference-time framework that uses an action-conditioned world model to adaptively determine action chunk execution length by detecting agreement among imagined future outcomes, improving robot manipulation policies without retraining.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了CA3C，一种推理时框架，利用动作条件世界模型，通过检测想象未来结果的一致性来自适应确定动作块的执行长度，无需重新训练即可改进机器人操作策略。
summary_zh: 动作分块策略预测多步控制序列，但一个基本问题仍然存在：在重新规划之前，应执行预测动作块的多大前缀？现有系统通常执行固定长度的前缀，隐式假设相同的执行时域在各种状态下均保持可信。部分自适应方法根据预测动作的相似性或稳定性来估计该时域。然而，不同的动作可能导致相同的成功结果，而相似的动作可能产生不同的未来状态，这表明决策的提交应由想象未来的一致性决定，而非动作空间中的相似性。为此，我们提出了一种基于后果的自适应动作分块（CA$^3$C）方法，这是一种推理时框架，其构建于一个简单原则之上：当想象的未来一致时提交执行，当它们出现分歧时重新规划。CA$^3$C无需修改或重新训练基础策略，而是利用动作条件世界模型，在相同采样噪声下想象多个候选动作块的未来后果。基于这些想象后果，我们将执行时域估计建模为贝叶斯变点推断问题，并通过未来共识选择执行候选。在多个仿真基准和真实机器人操作任务中，CA$^3$C持续改进了多种动作分块策略，相较于相应基础策略，失败率相对降低最高达71.8%。

title: Adapting Vision-Language-Action Models to Unknown Visual Disruptions During Execution
summary: Visual disruptions can arise while a robot is executing a task, leaving a vision-language-action (VLA) policy to respond without knowing the disruption type or timing. We introduce Self-supervised Adaptation from Leftover Trajectories (SALT), which uses the leftover trajectory, the unexecuted part of the previous action chunk, as self-supervision for test-time adaptation. Because consecutive chunks overlap in time, the leftover provides a temporally aligned target for the current prediction over the same future control interval. At the onset of a visual shift, the leftover can retain a plan formed before the corruption, so updating the policy toward it anchors the adaptation across the shift (Transition Anchoring). SALT keeps the adapted policy and regenerates the current chunk, whose leftover becomes the target at the next replan, carrying the correction forward along the execution trajectory (Sequential Correction Propagation). Supervision comes entirely from the policy's own predictions, requiring no disruption annotations, expert actions, or target-domain demonstrations, and a lightweight adaptation gate calibrated only on nominal trajectories decides when updates begin. On LIBERO-10, SALT increases average success across five persistent visual corruptions from 43.9% to 53.2% with SmolVLA and from 58.7% to 66.0% with GR00T N1.7, while largely preserving nominal performance. On a real robot, it raises task progress averaged over digital and physical disruptions from 0.49 to 0.61.
tldr: SALT adapts VLA policies to unknown visual disruptions at test time using leftover action chunks as self-supervision, improving success under corruptions on LIBERO and real robots.
tldr_zh: SALT 利用未执行的行动块作为自监督信号，在测试时使 VLA 策略适应未知视觉干扰，在 LIBERO 和真实机器人上提升了干扰下的成功率。
summary_zh: 机器人在执行任务时可能会遇到视觉干扰，而此时视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略需要在不知道干扰类型或发生时机的情况下作出响应。我们提出了一种名为“来自剩余轨迹的自监督适应”（SALT）的方法，该方法利用剩余轨迹——即前一动作块中未执行的部分——作为测试时适应的自监督信号。由于连续的动作块在时间上存在重叠，剩余轨迹为当前预测在相同的未来控制区间内提供了一个时间对齐的目标。在视觉偏移刚发生时，剩余轨迹能够保留偏移发生前形成的计划，因此将策略向该计划更新，可将适应过程锚定在偏移之上（过渡锚定）。SALT保留适应后的策略并重新生成当前动作块，其剩余轨迹在下一次重新规划时成为目标，从而将修正沿执行轨迹向前传递（顺序修正传播）。监督信号完全来自策略自身的预测，无需干扰标注、专家动作或目标域演示，并且一个仅在名义轨迹上校准的轻量级适应门控决定何时开始更新。在LIBERO-10基准上，SALT将SmolVLA在五种持续性视觉干扰下的平均成功率从43.9%提升至53.2%，将GR00T N1.7从58.7%提升至66.0%，同时基本保持名义性能不变。在真实机器人上，SALT将数字干扰和物理干扰下的任务进度平均值从0.49提升至0.61。

title: PACE: Stage-Consistent Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation via Progress-Aligned Context for Execution
summary: Demonstration-conditioned policies provide a natural interface for specifying robot behavior, yet long-horizon manipulation remains difficult when visually similar states recur across different stages or when demonstrations and executions proceed at different speeds. We identify the resulting failure mode as stage confusion and introduce Progress-Aligned Context for Execution (PACE), a stateful method that continually reinterprets a complete demonstration according to realized execution progress. PACE compresses the demonstration into ordered multimodal prompt tokens and uses training-only dual-edge attention supervision to expose its latent stage structure. During execution, an episode-local fast-weight memory causally encodes realized action-observation transitions and modulates prompt cross-attention, producing a progress-aligned context for a unified diffusion action expert without test-time stage labels or stage-specific policies. PACE improves success from 88.9% to 94.0% on LIBERO-Gen Goal Chain, from 79.1% to 83.3% on Spatial Combination, and from 33.3% to 73.3% on the two-step Block Routing tasks. Failure analysis further indicates that structured demonstration alignment and causal execution memory jointly mitigate stage confusion.
tldr: PACE introduces a stateful method that aligns demonstrations with execution progress via a causal fast-weight memory to reduce stage confusion in long-horizon robot manipulation, improving success rates on LIBERO and Block Routing benchmarks.
tldr_zh: PACE提出了一种状态方法，通过因果快速权重记忆将演示与执行进度对齐，以减少长时程机器人操作中的阶段混淆，并在LIBERO和Block Routing基准上提高了成功率。
summary_zh: 演示条件化策略为指定机器人行为提供了一种自然的接口，然而当不同阶段出现视觉上相似的状态，或演示与执行以不同速度进行时，长时程操控仍然困难重重。我们将由此产生的失败模式识别为阶段混淆，并提出了执行进度对齐上下文（PACE），这是一种有状态的方法，可根据已实现的执行进度持续重新解读完整演示。PACE将演示压缩为有序的多模态提示令牌，并利用仅训练时的双侧注意力监督来揭示其潜在阶段结构。在执行过程中，一个回合局部的快权重记忆以因果方式编码已实现的动作-观测转换，并调制提示交叉注意力，从而为统一的扩散动作专家生成进度对齐的上下文，无需测试时的阶段标签或阶段专属策略。PACE在LIBERO-Gen目标链任务上将成功率从88.9%提升至94.0%，在空间组合任务上从79.1%提升至83.3%，并在两步模块路由任务上从33.3%提升至73.3%。失败分析进一步表明，结构化的演示对齐与因果执行记忆共同缓解了阶段混淆问题。

title: Beyond Retargeting: Low-Latency and Robust Humanoid Whole-Body Teleoperation with Learned Atomic Motion Primitives
summary: Humanoid whole-body teleoperation translates human motion into stable robot behavior in real time. Existing systems typically rely on online motion retargeting to bridge human--robot morphological differences, but this process adds latency and can produce physically infeasible targets. Meanwhile, diverse, noisy, and partial human-motion observations often fall outside the training distribution, potentially causing unstable robot behavior. We propose a retargeting-free policy that maps raw human motion directly to robot joint commands in a single forward pass, eliminating online kinematic adaptation. To improve robustness, we learn a codebook of full-body motion primitives that projects out-of-distribution observations onto plausible motion prototypes and recovers full-body motion from partial inputs. Experiments on a Unitree~G1 in simulation and on hardware, using virtual reality, optical mocap, text-to-motion generation, and monocular video inputs, show that our method outperforms baselines in latency and robustness.
tldr: This paper proposes a retargeting-free humanoid whole-body teleoperation policy that maps raw human motion to robot joint commands in a single forward pass, using a learned codebook of motion primitives to enhance robustness and reduce latency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种无需重定位的人形机器人全身遥操作策略，通过单次前向传播将原始人体动作映射为机器人关节指令，并利用学习到的运动原语码本提高鲁棒性、降低延迟。
summary_zh: 类人全身遥操作技术能够将人体运动实时转化为稳定的机器人行为。现有系统通常依赖在线运动重定向来弥合人与机器人之间的形态差异，但这一过程增加了延迟，并可能产生物理上不可行的目标。同时，多样化、含噪声及部分的人体运动观测往往超出训练数据分布范围，可能导致机器人行为不稳定。我们提出了一种免重定向策略，通过单次前向传播将原始人体运动直接映射为机器人关节指令，从而消除了在线运动学适配的需求。为提升鲁棒性，我们构建了一个全身运动原语码本，可将分布外观测投影至合理的运动原型，并能从部分输入恢复全身运动。在仿真及实体Unitree G1上，利用虚拟现实、光学动作捕捉、文本生成运动及单目视频输入所开展的实验表明，我们的方法在延迟与鲁棒性方面均优于基线方法。

title: Model-Based Geometry-Aware Generative Optimization for Constrained Locomotion Planning
summary: Constrained Locomotion Planning (CLP) for quadrupeds and humanoids, where robots must satisfy collision avoidance, contact consistency, kinematic feasibility, and support constraints, is challenging under high-dimensional dynamics and highly non-convex environments. Recent Model-Based Diffusion (MBD) approaches recast trajectory optimization as posterior sampling over trajectories, using known dynamics and Monte Carlo rollouts to analytically estimate the denoising score function without demonstration learning. While constrained variants further incorporate feasibility into model-based score rollouts and show promising performance, they are still limited by (1) lacking a task-modulated active constraint geometry that shapes the score direction and reverse stochasticity, and (2) using deterministic DDPM-style reverse transport without adaptive scheduling across different generative transports. Therefore, we introduce Model-Based Geometry-Aware Generative Optimization (2GO) for constrained locomotion, which turns active constraint geometry into executable denoising operators through normal- induced metric shaping, tangent-space stochastic filtering, and CFS-based retraction. 2GO further decouples generative transport from reverse stochasticity through an adaptive diffusion and flow-like schedule. Experiments on constrained quadruped and humanoid locomotion demonstrate strong performance in discrete foothold selection and continuous posture planning, with higher success rates, fewer violations, and improved execution compatibility.
tldr: This paper introduces 2GO, a model-based geometry-aware generative optimization method for constrained locomotion planning in quadrupeds and humanoids, which uses active constraint geometry to shape denoising and an adaptive diffusion/flow-like schedule to improve success rates and reduce violations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了2GO，一种基于模型且几何感知的生成优化方法，用于四足和人形机器人的约束运动规划，通过主动约束几何引导去噪并采用自适应扩散/流调度，提高了成功率和减少了违规。
summary_zh: 约束式运动规划（CLP）针对四足机器人与仿人机器人，要求机器人在高维动力学与高度非凸环境中满足碰撞避免、接触一致性、运动学可行性及支撑约束，这一问题极具挑战性。近年来，基于模型的扩散（MBD）方法将轨迹优化重构为轨迹上的后验采样问题，利用已知动力学和蒙特卡洛 rollout，在不依赖示范学习的情况下解析估计去噪得分函数。尽管带约束的变体进一步将可行性纳入基于模型的得分 rollout 中，并展现出良好的性能，但仍存在两方面的局限：（1）缺乏任务调制的主动约束几何结构来塑造得分方向与反向随机性；（2）采用确定性 DDPM 式反向传输，未在不同生成传输之间进行自适应调度。为此，我们提出基于模型的几何感知生成优化（2GO）方法用于约束式运动规划，通过法向诱导度量整形、切空间随机滤波以及基于 CFS 的收缩操作，将主动约束几何结构转化为可执行去噪算子。2GO 进一步通过自适应扩散与类流调度，将生成传输与反向随机性解耦。在约束四足与仿人运动上的实验表明，该方法在离散落脚点选择与连续姿态规划中均表现出强劲性能，具有更高的成功率、更少的违规次数以及更好的执行兼容性。

title: StairVLA: Stage-Aware Hierarchical Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly rely on diffusion- or flow-matching-based action heads to generate continuous robot actions. These action heads typically process the denoising trajectory in a largely uniform manner. However, we observe that the conditioning focus naturally shifts across denoising stages: early stages combine language instructions and visual observations to establish a coarse action trajectory, whereas later stages place greater emphasis on current visual observations for action alignment. Based on this insight, we introduce StairVLA, a stage-aware hierarchical action generation framework that uses partially denoised actions as a natural interface between coarse long-horizon action generation and local refinement. A high-level VLA performs early denoising to produce a reusable long-horizon partially denoised action trajectory, while a lightweight refiner operates at a higher frequency to refine local action chunks using the latest observations. This design amortizes expensive high-level VLA computation while preserving frequent closed-loop correction. On LIBERO, our GR00T-style instantiation improves average success from 96.5% to 97.8% while reducing amortized inference latency from 115.0 ms to 44.2 ms per action chunk. More broadly, across two VLA backbones, simulation benchmarks, and real-robot tasks, StairVLA consistently reduces inference cost while maintaining strong task performance.
tldr: StairVLA introduces a stage-aware hierarchical action generation framework for VLA models, using partially denoised actions as an interface to decouple coarse long-horizon generation from frequent local refinement, reducing inference cost while improving success rates on simulation and real-robot tasks.
tldr_zh: StairVLA 提出了一种面向 VLA 模型的分阶段层次化动作生成框架，利用部分去噪动作作为接口，将粗粒度长时程动作生成与高频局部细化解耦，在降低推理开销的同时在仿真和真实机器人任务上提升了成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型日益依赖基于扩散或流匹配的动作头来生成连续的机器人动作。这类动作头通常以近乎统一的方式处理去噪轨迹。然而，我们观察到，条件关注的焦点在不同去噪阶段自然发生转移：早期阶段结合语言指令和视觉观察以建立粗略的动作轨迹，而后期阶段则更侧重于当前视觉观察以进行动作对齐。基于这一发现，我们提出了StairVLA，一种阶段感知的分层动作生成框架，利用部分去噪后的动作作为粗粒度长时程动作生成与局部细化之间的自然接口。高层VLA执行早期去噪，生成可复用的长时程部分去噪动作轨迹，而轻量级细化器则以更高频率运行，利用最新观测对局部动作块进行细化。该设计分摊了昂贵的高层VLA计算成本，同时保持了频繁的闭环修正能力。在LIBERO基准上，我们的GR00T风格实例将平均成功率从96.5%提升至97.8%，同时将每个动作块的摊销推理延迟从115.0毫秒降低至44.2毫秒。更广泛地，在两种VLA主干网络、仿真基准以及真实机器人任务中，StairVLA在保持强劲任务性能的同时，始终降低了推理成本。

title: CoRE: Learning Collaboration-Role Experts for Decentralized Collaborative Manipulation with One Policy
summary: Collaborative manipulation requires robots to perform complementary actions as interactions unfold. We study single-policy decentralized collaboration: every robot runs the same policy from its visual observations and proprioception, without task prompts, identity labels, or inter-robot messages. The challenge is to learn complementary team behaviors within shared parameters and select appropriate actions from each robot's local observations. We introduce CoRE, which learns Collaboration-Role Experts from pooled multi-task, multi-robot demonstrations. Fused appearance and geometry provide local interaction evidence. Query-conditioned cross-attention experts provide adaptable prediction paths, which a local router combines at each action-chunk position. During training, an action-expert alignment loss supervises expert selection using relative forced-route prediction errors against demonstrations under fixed inputs, without role labels.
